subject: MSA & commercial: pricing schedule, min commit, and net terms
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marta Kuznetsova <marta@clearwave.com>, Clearwave Health Procurement <procurement@clearwave.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA & commercial: pricing schedule, min commit, and net terms

Hi Marta / procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attached are two artifacts we discussed:
- Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (our latest redlines on the MSA)
- pricing_schedule_CLEARWAVE.xlsx (proposed pricing bands + minimum commit ladder)

A couple of asks to keep this moving:
1) Can you confirm the billing entity and PO number you want us to invoice against? (Your PO will speed acceptance.)
2) Net terms: you mentioned Net 60 on the call. Our standard is Net 30; for strategic partners we can consider Net 45 with a 30% upfront on the first invoice. Can you confirm internal approvals for Net 45? 
3) Tax handling: if Clearwave is in scope for reverse-charge (EU only) or needs gross-up language, please advise and attach tax certificate if available.

Target: sign MSA + countersigned order form by Sep 15 so the pilot can start the week of Sep 20.

Attaching for your review. Happy to hop on a short call if legal wants to walk the redlines.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: pricing_schedule_CLEARWAVE.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Marta Kuznetsova <marta@clearwave.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Clearwave Health Procurement <procurement@clearwave.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & commercial: pricing schedule, min commit, and net terms

Rishi —

Thanks for sending. We've circulated the MSA redline to Legal and Procurement. A few quick points from Procurement:
- PO attached: Clearwave_PO_5921.pdf
- Net 60 is our baseline; Procurement is willing to accept Net 45 with Finance sign-off. Can Redwood confirm acceptance of Net 45 in writing?
- Billing entity on the PO is Clearwave Health, Inc.; please confirm you can invoice the same entity.

Legal will review your redline; they'll likely push back on a few indemnity items but that's separate. I'll loop back with approvals by end of day tomorrow (9/9).

—Marta
Director, Vendor Management
Clearwave Health

[Attachment: Clearwave_PO_5921.pdf (PDF)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-08T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Clearwave — recommended commercial response

Team —

Read the PO and external reply. My recommended commercial posture for Finance/Legal:
- Offer Net45 (compromise) with a 30% upfront charge on the first invoice. This reduces billing risk and aligns with our Dedicated onboarding costs.
- Accept billing entity = Clearwave Health, Inc. but require PO references the Deal ID: DEAL-7842 and the MSA signature page.
- Minimum commit ladder: adjust the scheduling to 60/30/10 split across quarters (see attached commercials_summary_7842.xlsx). This keeps total commit the same but staggers recognition.
- Tax: require customer to provide tax residency certificate if they expect reverse-charge; until then Redwood defaults to charging applicable sales tax/VAT.

If Legal wants to make concessions on indemnity, force allocate credit exposure in the order form (not MSA). I'll attach the summary and a clean order form template.

Kimberly
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: commercials_summary_7842.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-09T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Clearwave — recommended commercial response

Agree with Kim. Two addenda:
- For EU customers (if any of Clearwave entities bill in EU), add reverse-charge evidence clause: require EU VAT number + certificate. Otherwise we'll charge VAT and it's on the customer to reclaim.
- Pricing schedule: I updated the pricing bands so first tranche has a slightly higher per-token rate to offset the upfront discount. See pricing_schedule_CLEARWAVE.xlsx.

If we commit to Net45 + 30% upfront, mark the deal as "finance-approved pending PO & KYC" in HubSpot.

Ben
Senior Sales Operations

[Attachment: pricing_schedule_CLEARWAVE.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marta Kuznetsova <marta@clearwave.com>, Clearwave Health Procurement <procurement@clearwave.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-09T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & commercial: pricing schedule, min commit, and net terms — Redwood position

Hi Marta — thanks for the PO and quick turnaround.

To summarize Redwood's position so Procurement & Finance have it in writing:
- Net terms: We can move to Net 45 (approved) provided we receive a 30% upfront invoice on the first scheduled invoice.
- Billing entity: We will invoice Clearwave Health, Inc. referencing PO 5921 and Deal ID DEAL-7842.
- Minimum commit: We'll adopt the 60/30/10 quarterly ladder (per attached commercial summary) with the same overall committed spend.
- Taxes: If Clearwave expects reverse-charge treatment, please send the VAT/tax certificate; otherwise Redwood will collect VAT/sales tax per jurisdiction.
- Next steps: Please have Procurement confirm Net45 + 30% upfront approval and return a signed MSA + countersigned Order Form. If you prefer, we can generate the final Order Form and send for signature — let us know.

I'll hold the MSA redline open for legal to negotiate but getting Proc sign-off on Net45/30% upfront moves us to execution.

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: commercials_summary_7842.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Marta Kuznetsova <marta@clearwave.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Clearwave Health Procurement <procurement@clearwave.com>
Date: 2027-09-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA & commercial: pricing schedule, min commit, and net terms — Redwood position

Rishi —

Procurement confirms Net45 + 30% upfront is acceptable pending Finance sign-off (I expect confirmation by COB tomorrow 9/11). I will also push Legal to prioritize the limited indemnity redlines.

We will circulate for signature once Legal clears the MSA redlines and Finance confirms the Net45 approval. Expect a signed PO/Order Form by Sep 14 if all goes well.

I'll reply with tax certificate if Finance requests it.

Best,
Marta
Director, Vendor Management
Clearwave Health
